title: reliab mutation baseline
description: The file the profile's mutation_baseline names: a recorded mutation score per scope that new work must not fall below, a ratchet. It is a protected path: a person writes it with reliab baseline write and commits it (R2). See knowledge/decisions/mutation-threshold.md.

path.description: Glob of the repo-relative files the scope covers, e.g. src/Billing/**.

command.description: The mutation command whose report the score was recorded from.

treeHash.description: The tree that report ran against.
